text.en: Direct hits do more damage to combatant shields. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.
Direct hits do more damage to combatant shields. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.

Deal 24.5% increased impact damage to Combatant Shields.

Dealing damage grants 70 Reload Speed for 7 seconds. Direct Hits apply <void/>Volatile to the target and enemies in a 7? meter radius.

For 6 seconds after either scoring a kill with another weapon or dealing Fighting Lion damage, performing the other action <title refills [G_refill] /> Fighting Lion's magazine.
